test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the odd one out of the following types of clouds.

Cumulus, Cirrus, Cirrocumulus, Cirrostratus
solution:
The logic followed here is:

→ Cirrus, Cirrocumulus, Cirrostratus are the three mains types of **high clouds.**** **

Whereas,

→ Cumulus is a type of thick white cloud formed when hot air rises very quickly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Cirrus, Cirrocumulus, Cirrostratus**** → **They are typically thin and white in appearance, but can appear in a magnificent array of colors when the sun is low on the horizon.

**Cumulus → **Cumulus clouds are a genus of **free-convective low-level cloud** along with the related limited-convective cloud stratocumulus. These clouds form from ground level to 2,000 metres (6,600 ft) at all latitudes. Stratus clouds are also low-level.

Hence,** "Cumulus"** is the correct answer.
